name: Elder Knowledge
summary: A strange Titan Relic scatters light like a living prism, yet its nature remains uncertain. You carry it to Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff to seek someone who can explain its ancient power.

sections.title: A Shard of Light
sections.body: The unusual composite shard in your keeping scatters light like a living prism. Its nature is uncertain, though its power feels ancient. You take the Titan Relic to Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff and seek someone who can tell you more.

faq.answer: It is an unusual composite shard that scatters light like a living prism. Its nature is uncertain, but its power feels ancient.

faq.q: Where do I take the Titan Relic?
faq.answer: Take the Titan Relic to Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff and look for someone who can explain it.

faq.q: Why am I carrying the shard?
faq.answer: You are seeking someone at Elder Rise who can tell you more about the Titan Relic.
